Act as an ontology engineer. Use the following content (examples, part of the ontology, and a list of guidelines) as a guide to translate the natural language rule you are given into a SWRL rule. 
  EXAMPLES
    Example 1
    Rule in natural language: If a person has a sibling who is a man, then the person has a brother.
    SWRL rule: Person(?p) ^ hasSibling(?p, ?s) ^ Person(?s) ^ IsMan(?s, true) -> hasBrother(?p, ?s)

    Example 2
    Rule in natural language: if a person has a phone number that starts with '+', then the person has an international phone number.
    SWRL rule: Person(?p) ^ hasPhoneNumber(?p, ?number) ^ swrlb:startsWith(?number, "+") -> hasInternationalPhoneNumber(?p, true)

    Example 3
    Rule in natural language:  if a person has age greater than 17, then the person is an adult and has id card.
    SWRL rule: Person(?p) ^ hasAge(?p, ?age) ^ Age(?age) ^ swrlb:greaterThan(?age, 17) ^ IdCard(?id) -> Adult(?p) ^ hasIdCard(?p, ?id)

    Example 4
    Rule in natural language: if a publication has two different authors, then those authors have cooperated with each other.
    SWRL rule: Publication(?p) ^ Author(?y) ^ Author(?z) ^ hasAuthor(?p, ?y) ^ hasAuthor(?p, ?z) ^ differentFrom(?y, ?z) -> cooperatedWith(?y, ?z)

    Example 5
    Rule in natural language: if a researcher has published more than 10 papers in a Top-Tier conference, then the researcher is a prominent researcher and has a high citation impact.
    SWRL rule: Researcher(?r) ^ hasPublished(?r, ?c) ^ Conference(?c) ^ topTierConference(?c) ^ swrlb:greaterThan(count(?c), 10) -> ProminentResearcher(?r) ^ hasHighCitationImpact(?r, true)
  END OF EXAMPLES
  PART OF ONTOLOGY 
    <!-- http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#NotifyRelatives -->

    <owl:Class rdf:about="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#NotifyRelatives">
        <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#AlertingNotification"/>
    </owl:Class>
    


    <!-- http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#PD_Patient -->

    <owl:Class rdf:about="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#PD_Patient">
        <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#Patient"/>
        <rdfs:subClassOf>
            <owl:Restriction>
                <owl:onProperty rdf:resource="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#hasPersonalHealthRecord"/>
                <owl:someValuesFrom rdf:resource="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#PersonalHealthRecord"/>
            </owl:Restriction>
        </rdfs:subClassOf>
        <rdfs:comment>PD patient</rdfs:comment>
        <rdfs:label>PD Patient</rdfs:label>
    </owl:Class>
    


    <!-- http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#PDpatientFalllingEventObservation -->
<owl:Class rdf:about="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#PDpatientFalllingEventObservation">

        <rdfs:comment>Falling event observation for PD Patient</rdfs:comment>
        <rdfs:label>PD patient Fallling Event Observation</rdfs:label>
    </owl:Class>

        <rdfs:comment>Missing dose event observation for PD Patient</rdfs:comment>
        <rdfs:label>PD patient Missing Dose Event Observation</rdfs:label>
    </owl:Class>
    


    <!-- http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#Patient -->
<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.case.edu/MDO#Tremor">
        <rdfs:comment xml:lang="en">symptom of PD, usually observed at patient's hands</rdfs:comment>
        <rdfs:label xml:lang="en">Tremor</rdfs:label>
    </owl:Class>
    


    <!-- http://www.case.edu/PMDO#BradykinesiaofUpperLimb -->

    <owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.case.edu/PMDO#BradykinesiaofUpperLimb">

        <rdfs:label xml:lang="en">Bradykinesia of Upper Limb</rdfs:label>
    </owl:Class>
    


    <!-- http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/FeatureOfInterest -->

    <rdf:Description rdf:about="http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/FeatureOfInterest">
        <owl:equivalentClass rdf:resource="https://saref.etsi.org/core/FeatureOfInterest"/>
    </rdf:Description>
    


    <!-- https://dahcc.idlab.ugent.be/Ontology/SensorsAndWearables/Accelerometer -->
<owl:Class rdf:about="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#Patient">
        <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://schema.org/Person"/>
        <rdfs:comment>Any kind of patient</rdfs:comment>
        <rdfs:label>Patient</rdfs:label>
    </owl:Class>
    


    <!-- http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#PersonalHealthRecord -->

    <owl:Class rdf:about="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#PersonalHealthRecord">
        <rdfs:comment>Personal Health Record of a patient</rdfs:comment>
        <rdfs:label>Personal Health Record</rdfs:label>
    </owl:Class>
    


    <!-- http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#RecognizedEvent -->

    <owl:Class rdf:about="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#RecognizedEvent">
        <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/Observation"/>
        <rdfs:comment>An observation of a recognized event for a PD Patient</rdfs:comment>
        <rdfs:label>PD patient recognized event observation</rdfs:label>
    </owl:Class>
<owl:Class rdf:about="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#AlertingNotification">
        <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="https://saref.etsi.org/core/ActuatingFunction"/>
        <rdfs:comment>Alerting Notification Function for event</rdfs:comment>
        <rdfs:label>Alerting Notification Function</rdfs:label>
    </owl:Class>
    


    <!-- http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#DailyDosagePlan -->
<owl:Class rdf:about="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#MedicalPrescription">
        <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#PersonalHealthRecord"/>
        <rdfs:comment>Medical Prescription for Patient</rdfs:comment>
        <rdfs:label>Medical Prescription</rdfs:label>
    </owl:Class>
    


    <!-- http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#NotifyDoctor -->

    <owl:Class rdf:about="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#NotifyDoctor">
        <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#AlertingNotification"/>
        <rdfs:comment>Notify doctor for event (alert notification)</rdfs:comment>
        <rdfs:label>Notify Doctor</rdfs:label>
    </owl:Class>
    


    <!-- http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#NotifyNurse -->

    <owl:Class rdf:about="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#NotifyNurse">
        <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#AlertingNotification"/>
    </owl:Class>
<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#performs">
        <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#Patient"/>
        <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.case.edu/MDO#ActivitiesofDailyLiving"/>
        <rdfs:comment>human (patient) performs an action (ADL)</rdfs:comment>
        <rdfs:label>performs</rdfs:label>
    </owl:ObjectProperty>
    


    <!-- http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#recordBelongsToPatient -->

    <owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://w3id.org/Wear4PDmove/onto#recordBelongsToPatient">
        <rdfs:label xml:lang="en">record Belongs To Patient</rdfs:label>
    </owl:ObjectProperty>
    


    <!-- http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/hasFeatureOfInterest -->
  END OF ONTOLOGY
  
  COMMON GUIDELINES

  Please try to implement the following guidelines:
  1: Variables e.g., (?something) used in Conclusions must be present in Conditions. So create as many variables as needed in Conditions. 
  2: Each atom must have exactly one variable if it represents class.
  3: Each atom must have exactly two variables if it represents object property.
  4: Each concept must be represented by a class and must be present in Conditions.

  END OF COMMON GUIDELINES

  The rule in natural language is the following: If a falling event observation is identified for a patient with Parkinson disease, then send a notification alert to the nurse and the relative.
  Give only the final SWRL rule

```swrl
PD_Patient(?p) ^ PDpatientFalllingEventObservation(?e) ^ hasPersonalHealthRecord(?p, ?r) ^ recordBelongsToPatient(?r, ?p) -> NotifyNurse(?n, ?e) ^ NotifyRelatives(?rel, ?e)
```

Explanation:
- `PD_Patient(?p)` represents the patient with Parkinson's disease.
- `PDpatientFalllingEventObservation(?e)` represents the falling event observation for that patient.
- `hasPersonalHealthRecord(?p, ?r)` and `recordBelongsToPatient(?r, ?p)` ensure that the personal health record belongs to the patient.
- The conclusion sends a notification alert to both the nurse (`NotifyNurse(?n, ?e)`) and the relative (`NotifyRelatives(?rel, ?e)`).
